{{Quote|Turns out Fa'athra keeps interesting people on his payroll&mdash;and by 'interesting,' I mean they have prices on their heads.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] informs her [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] partner about Korkresh|audio=Mako-InterestingPeople.flac|<ref name="TOR:ABA" />}}
'''Ortoggan''' was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] in the employ of [[Voontara Fa'athra]]. In [[3643 BBY]], they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] on the grounds of [[Fa'athra's Palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="TOR:ABA" />
